title: Assign jobs people can actually finish
applies_when: Colonists are idle or urgent work is losing to other jobs.
approach: Assign cooking, growing and construction to capable workers with suitable skills. Keep hauling and cleaning covered; a colony of specialists still needs deliveries.
With manual priorities enabled, lower numbers run first; equal priorities follow the work-tab order. Do not put everything at priority 1.
Check the whole job chain: blueprint or designation, allowed reachable inputs, enabled work type, and an available worker. Change the missing link instead of repeatedly issuing the same order.
Research can fill spare time, but should not starve urgent planting, cooking or patient care of their only qualified worker.
verify: Incapabilities, current jobs, material deliveries and completed work across observations.
reconsider: Rest, injury, reservations or another urgent job explains the delay.
